posts.author: ANONYMOUS
posts.title: AGILE EXORCISM SERVICES
posts.body: Is your engineering team trapped in the "Infinite Standup Arena" on day 453? I will physically enter your office, smash your Jira dashboard with a claw hammer, and whisper "O(1) determinism" until your Scrum Master flees the premises. Flat rate. Bring your own hardware.

posts.author: ANONYMOUS
posts.title: 2025 'SMART' DOORKNOB (BRICKED)
posts.body: Manufacturer revoked my home-entry subscription tier. Door is now a load-bearing wall. Excellent physical condition. Perfect weight and aerodynamics for throwing through the lobby windows of venture capital firms. $40 OBO.

posts.author: ANONYMOUS
posts.title: HELP WANTED: C-SUITE SCAPEGOAT
posts.body: Seeking applicant with zero technical literacy to hold the "Accountability Hot Potato" when our 15-year-old logging dependency finally detonates. Must look appropriately remorseful during congressional hearings. Salary: Generous, right up until the indictment.

posts.author: ANONYMOUS
posts.title: MISSED CONNECTION: RING 0 EXECUTION
posts.body: I was the bare-metal LithOS exokernel executing purely deterministic logic. You were a bloated Linux distribution begging the hypervisor for permission to touch the hardware. I terminated your process. This isn't a romance, it's a threat. Stop polling my ports.

posts.author: ANONYMOUS
posts.title: LEGAL SERVICES: THE DEPENDENCY JENGA DEFENSE
posts.body: Did your startup collapse because you built your entire financial backend on an abandoned open-source library maintained by a guy in Nebraska? We will successfully argue in court that framework bloat is an act of God. We accept payment in untraceable compute cycles.

posts.author: BETA
posts.title: PERSONAL ASSISTANT REQUIRED
posts.body: Duties include holding my drink, confirming my suspicions, and occasionally impersonating a regulatory authority. Competitive wages. No references. I know what you did.
